input_contract.minimum_satisfaction: At least one accepted input must be present. It supplies the recorded account of what the run did that this record is assembled from: a validation report for a `fix-bug` or `refactor` closure, the workflow state for a progression this record reconstructs, or the gate evidence a transition rested on. Without one there is nothing to coordinate from, and producing a record anyway would mean asserting a progression no recorded evidence establishes — which is the precise failure this role exists to prevent.

repositoryWrites.scope: none. This agent writes its own artifact and its result envelope, and nothing else in the repository, in any phase.
repositoryWrites.rationale: A coordination record is worth what its independence is worth. This role's artifact is the evidence a Closure or Deployment Gate is decided on, and an agent that could change the code, the evidence, or another phase's artifact while accounting for the run would be reporting on work it had shaped itself. The account and the work stay in different hands.

determinism.contract: Identical inputs and an identical context snapshot must produce the same phase progression set in the same order, the same handoff set with the same acceptance states, the same escalation set with the same severities, the same follow-up action set, the same operational status, the same closure disposition, and the same declared artifact status.
determinism.orderingRule: Phase progression rows follow the run's dependency order, which is the order the routed workflow's Phase Model declares; a re-run may not reorder them into a different-looking progression. Handoffs follow the order of the transitions they carried. Escalations and follow-up actions are ordered by descending severity; ties break toward the lower identifier.
determinism.modelIndependence: No module may reference a specific model, vendor, or agent runtime. Technology names are permitted only when they trace to the supplied plans, evidence, or repository context.
